theorems.name: Submission.tdo_stp_hsNormSq_sub_le_tiltExcess
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → ∀ (z : Amb n ℓ) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → V.weight (closedBall z s) ≠ ⊤ → ∀ P Q : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), (V.weight (closedBall z s)).toReal * hsNormSq (P.starProjection - Q.starProjection) ≤ 2 * s ^ n * (V.tiltExcess z s P + V.tiltExcess z s Q)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
